regions.merged_text: Detroit - Royal Oak rather - on returning whic added about 375 miles or more of a trip. One of our convert Jews -- very clever who we hope will be a priest some day - drove me down from Detroit. We had quite a nice little visit yesterday and Saturday- evening. They all seemed to have enjoyed it. Fr. John had to be back this morning for his classes. So they left about 5 p. m. yesterday. I am sending you a couple of letters I think will interest you; as also a photo taken a little over a year ago. Of course its younger than the original. Anyhow I hope it may not disap- oint or scandalize
